name: Calcom Vision Limited
about: Calcom Vision Limited manufactures and sells lighting and electronic products in India. The company's products portfolio includes light emitting diode (LED) battens and tubes, bulbs, and panels, as well as down lighters, driver and strip lights, and street and flood lights; emergency bulbs; high wattage led bulbs; PLL lamps; ceiling lights and specialty lightings; indoor and outdoor lightings; emergency lighting; luminaires; electronic ballasts; and other products, including BLDC fans and EV chargers. It also exports its products to Germany, the United States, Malaysia, China, and Singapore. Calcom Vision Limited was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Greater Noida, India.
